about: Psychology Shorts styles in rotation (Shivam, 2026-10-26). scripts/pick_style.py picks one AT RANDOM for each new script (no strict order); the only rule is never 3 in a row of the same style. To add a style: build its kit/engine, add an entry here, a folder shorts/styles/<id>/ with reference + cast pictures, and a section in STYLES.md.
